line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.Costs.Generic
* DESCRIPTION: Generic helper that scales the cost and recycle value of wares.
* DO NOT USE THIS FOR EQUIPMENT OR OUTPOST ITEMS. They have fixed costs.
* Arguments:
* - $outpost: the $outpost paying the costs.
* - $productPrice: the cost of the item. Item is a ship, station, shield, laser, or missile.
* - $wares: the wares used to craft the item or returned by salvaging.
* - $divider: crafting divider.
* - $specialization: specialization of an item type. Used only for manufacturing.
* - $qty: how many items to make or recycle.
* - $isRecycling: if [TRUE], returns recycle value. if [FALSE], returns production costs.
* - $recycleDivisor: 1, 5, or 100. Ships and stations use 1; missiles and most lasers use 5; shields and OCV lasers use 100.
* - $modifiers: optional table, used by ships:
* - $unitPercent: Applied before quantity.
* - $postQtyPercent: Applied after quantity.
* - $wareFactors: Table of per-ware numerator/denominator arrays.
* - $finalDiscountPercent: Applied last, manufacturing only.
* AUTHOR: DATE: 26 November 2026
* Recycling ignores manufacturing specialization.
* Add-Ons 1.1: Diminishing specialization returns.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Prevent manufacturing discounts from falling below the highest current recycling factor.
* Expanded 2.2.1: Resolve the actual Outpost factor once.
* Preserve the original whole-resource manufacturing base.
* Optional ordered modifiers, used by ship construction.
* Apply any resource-specific multiplier.
* Optional final manufacturing discount.
* Recycling must ignore this discount.
* Recycling: Apply the factor and category penalty after quantity and resource-specific modifiers.
* Truncate the final recycling yield to whole resources.
* Quotient/remainder avoids multiplying the entire material cost by the recycling factor.
